blurb: Guests can enjoy daily guided expeditions, island shuttle and taxi services, private charters, and specialty excursions such as charcuterie cruises and birding tours. Tours include visits to Masonboro Island, a pristine 8.5-mile barrier island accessible only by boat. The company operates custom boats including the Shamrock catamaran and the Clover pontoon boat.
extraNote: Reservations recommended for ferry and tours · BYOB allowed, alcohol permitted on boats · Private dock at 109 Causeway Dr, Wrightsville Beach, NC · Daily tours, Masonboro Island Ferry runs Monday-Saturday during summer season
